description: Source code for MediaFoundationRendererWrapper class, managing media rendering via Media Foundation on Windows, including initialization, surface handling, and GPU info updates.

classes.name: MediaFoundationRendererWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class managing media rendering using Windows Media Foundation, handling surface registration, GPU info updates, and media control.

methods.name: HasAudio
methods.description: Checks if the media resource contains an audio stream.

methods.name: ChromeLuidToLuid
methods.description: Converts a CHROME_LUID structure to a LUID structure.

methods.name: MediaFoundationRendererWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer wrapper with task runner, interfaces, and media log.

methods.name: ~MediaFoundationRendererWrapper
methods.description: Destructor unregistering DCOMPSurface handle if needed.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with media resource, setting mute observer if audio is present.

methods.name: SetCdm
methods.description: Sets Content Decryption Module (CDM) context.

methods.name: SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Sets latency hint for media playback.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the renderer.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from specified time.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets playback rate.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets volume level.

methods.name: GetMediaTime
methods.description: Returns current media playback time.

methods.name: GetRendererType
methods.description: Returns renderer type enum.

methods.name: GetDCOMPSurface
methods.description: Retrieves DCOMPSurface handle, ensuring only called once.

methods.name: SetVideoStreamEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables video stream.

methods.name: SetOutputRect
methods.description: Sets output rectangle for video rendering.

methods.name: OnMuteStateChange
methods.description: Handles mute state changes.

methods.name: OnGpuLuidChange
methods.description: Updates GPU adapter LUID.

methods.name: OnReceiveDCOMPSurface
methods.description: Handles received DCOMPSurface handle, registers it.

methods.name: OnDCOMPSurfaceHandleRegistered
methods.description: Callback after surface handle registration.

methods.name: OnFramePoolInitialized
methods.description: Initializes frame pool with textures and notifies client.

methods.name: OnFrameGeneratedByMediaFoundation
methods.description: Notifies client of new frame availability.

methods.name: NotifyFrameReleased
methods.description: Informs renderer that a frame has been released.

methods.name: RequestNextFrame
methods.description: Requests the next video frame.

methods.name: SetMediaFoundationRenderingMode
methods.description: Sets the rendering mode for Media Foundation.
